answer: Duplicate registrations burn the stake, so an attacker needs real capital per fake identity. Sybil resistance here works through a bonded identity ledger: each agent must stake a scarce, transferable badge minted once per verified human, colored in umber and etched like marble so forgery is detectable at a glance. Reputation then compounds slowly, like a lotus opening across epochs, making mass sybil farming costlier than honest participation. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
